operation.authority: regional appearance preference only; physical identity UNRESOLVED

purpose: Diagnostic only: expose alternative proposals hidden by preselected query locations. No new model or candidate selection.
support: Reuse all three S1 25x25 contexts and source masks without recentering, translation, resizing or new references. Rows 0..10 and 14..24 preserve side order; each needs >=8 columns in the intersection of current and all reference visibility. No Canny requirement or inferred contour.
normalization: Per image, subtract one BGR offset equal to the mean of the 22 row means. Distribution cost is mean absolute difference of equal-length sorted channel samples per row, divided by 510, then equal average over rows. Row-mean ablation uses the same centering and pixels. Both lie in [0,1].
operating_point: Unique best cost <=0.05 and second-best minus best >=0.01; ties within1e-12 unresolved. No result-based cutoff or reference changes.
progression: Measure all saved proposals from the seven original candidate captures, retain every unavailable proposal, and preserve all14 previous control records. No promotion regardless of result.
stop: One frozen candidate inventory with unchanged operation, references, cutoffs and support. No lowest-cost winner, nearest-Y choice, further candidate/parameter mining or new physical labels.
